en.title: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Debuts at #5 in Japanese Box Office Rankings
en.summary: The highly anticipated return of the Rakuen Tsuihō franchise has landed in the top 5 in Japan. Fans are celebrating the reunion of its iconic creative team.
en.body:
Fans of **Gen Urobuchi**'s visionary sci-fi world have reason to celebrate, as **Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance** has officially opened its theatrical run in Japan, debuting at number 5 in the TV series show rankings for the week of November 14-20, 2026. This strong opening signifies continued audience interest in the franchise, which first captivated viewers with its unique blend of high-concept philosophy and thrilling action.

The film marks a significant reunion for the core creative team that brought the original **Expelled from Paradise** to life. Director **Seiji Mizushima**, acclaimed scriptwriter **Gen Urobuchi** (known for his work on **Puella Magi Madoka Magica** and **Fate/Zero**), character designer **Masatsugu Saitō**, and composer **NARASAKI** have all returned to shepherd this new installment. Produced by the renowned **Toei Animation**, the sequel promises to deliver the same high-quality animation and intricate storytelling that fans have come to expect.

While the initial announcement mentioned titles like **Rakuen Tsuihō: Liberated from Paradise**, the final title, **Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance**, along with variations like **Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance**, reflects the project's evolution. This dedication to refining the narrative and presentation speaks volumes about the team's commitment to delivering a polished experience for the audience.

## A Resonant Return for a Beloved Franchise

The success of **Kokoro no Resonance** at the box office is a clear indicator of the franchise's dedicated fanbase. In a landscape often dominated by established IPs, a sequel to a decade-old film making such a strong debut speaks to the lasting impact of its themes and characters. The narrative arc of **Expelled from Paradise**, exploring humanity's relationship with technology and the nature of consciousness, clearly continues to resonate deeply with viewers. The anticipation for this film was palpable, fueled by the return of the original staff, and its performance validates the trust placed in this celebrated team.

## What's Next for Paradise

Beyond the film, the **Expelled from Paradise** universe is expanding further with a new game featuring an original story set to launch this winter. This multi-platform approach suggests a robust future for the franchise, offering fans multiple avenues to engage with its compelling world. With the film now captivating audiences in Japan, the global reception will be keenly watched as the **Rakuen Tsuihō** saga continues to unfold.
